name: Pimoroni Inky Frame 5.7" (7-colour ACeP)
description: 5.7 inch 600x448 Inky Frame (Pico W) with the 7-colour ACeP panel. Driven by the tesserae-inkyframe Pico SDK firmware over the REST device API: the pico_bin renderer's landscape 4-bpp buffer streams straight into the panel.
notes_md: Full refresh takes about 30 s. The firmware announces this kind on `/discover`; if the entry is missing it falls back to the stock `pico_bin_client` kind, whose 1600x1200 default panel produces frames the firmware refuses, so install this file before clicking Register.
